profile.headline: Software Engineer at Favor Delivery
profile.summary:
➢	Full Stack developer at Google and The Home Depot, experience in Front End and Back End over-hauls and rewrites in Java and Javascript
➢	Proficiency with React, Spring, and Concourse CI frameworks
➢	Utilized custom MVC frameworks to support user interface and backend support for cus-tomer communication preferences.
➢	Experience with GIT version control systems and code repositories for real time deploy-ment
➢	Participated in SCRUM process and project management for asset and feature delivery
➢	Software modeling with state, class, and use-case diagrams to plan projects from require-ments to deliverables, deployment, and maintenance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a framework using Google’s internal configuration language (GCL) and Java to enable
configurable email verification messaging for YouTube and Google Ads consumers, reducing tech debt, engineering
resources and time spent to develop future email templates.
• Developed, unit tested, and deployed features in Java enhancing the verification process for Google customers,
specifically countering cases where customer workflows were cancelled despite positive manual reviews.
• Gathered requirements and staged Spanner schema changes to enable Whitepages vendor integration for use by
wireless service providers, enabling a low friction way for operators to verify user authenticity.
• Migrated and managed verification policies for multiple countries using GCL, enforcing international requirements
for citizenship documents required to participate in local elections.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Extensive design and full-stack implementation experience with multiple teams within The Home Depot, including Identity & Security, Orders & Purchases and Checkout. 
•	Experience with crisis management - designed a token encoding solution over a holiday weekend that prevented mass fraudulent returns from bad actors in self-service pages
•	Designed and implemented a two-step sign-in system to The Home Depot’s authentication ecosystem
•	Integrated Enterprise Google ReCaptcha Version 3 to mitigate bot traffic, and incorporated vendor fraud systems such as ThreatMetrix for digital authentication
•	Collaborated with UX partners to design, prototype and build an updated Orders page where customers can see their curbside orders and look at their incoming shipments, implemented in React
•	Maintained and enhanced the Customer Account microservice, written in Java & Spring Boot, which returns profile information for authenticated users
•	Collaborated with Dev Ops & Site Reliability team to investigate and resolve costly issues on the E-Commerce platform and maintain our SLO
•	Implemented many front facing objectives for curbside pickup, including GraphQL integration, with React
•	Strong proficiency in backend Spring Boot solutions, actively overhauling code to meet best practice standards and using lambdas, generics, and abstraction to create a maintainable and secure backend platform to deliver THD customers their order detail in-formation
•	Used Node.js to develop a homebrew mock server that could be used to automate the deployment of LLC mocks on command, as well as categorize and find data based on key words and phrases. 
•	Expertise in React Redux and using state management, selectors and reusable components to create a much more performance driven front end experience for consumers searching for their orders. Key features include the overhaul of key tracking and shipping modals

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created over one hundred software solution fixes to ensure constant uptime of service within the context of an online pest control solution management system generating annual revenue in the range of hundreds of million dollars
•	Used PHP to  develop backend solutions to commercial problems such as batch payment resolution and creating custom voice messages while following a MVC framework
•	Utilized MySQL to generate queries polling customer data that populated customer reports pertaining to appointment and subscription information
•	Used use case, state, and activity diagrams to convert business requirements into project plans and processes for customer preference refactoring
•	Used HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Mustache templating language to create a solution that would dynamically add a perforated message to the end of an invoice of variable length
•	Committed and amended changes pertaining to software to various versions controls using GitHub
•	Negotiated and managed an office VoIP solution that catered to twenty-five employees by instantiating call routing, queues, phone provisioning, and network troubleshooting

positions.title: Lead mobile developer
positions.description:
•	Applied most recent open source mobile technology to design and develop cross-platform front-end applications that are usable in Android, iOS, and traditional Web environments.
•	Managed code discrepancies on an Android application using the Android Studio tool 
•	Acted as lead designer and developer in creating technical request for proposals and entity-relation modeling for a mobile application using Axure RP and draw.io
•	Experience in planning technical architecture and strategies for a social media application 
•	Converted client needs into user stories
•	Planned scalable data structures architecture and strategies for a social media application
•	Experience in creating node.js applications and pairing with REST APIs to achieve functionality in Ionic
•	Created a real time chat application using Ionic, socket.io and Cordova
•	Created a basic front-end interface in Ionic capable of photo storage, form data entry, and phone gallery selection
•	Angular.js development experience in creating an application capable of saving data from multiple users, as well as processing login and authentication

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
•	Passed certification in VMware vSphere Technical Sales Professional 5.5; achieved competency in Oracle e-business suites by passing technical sales certification exams offered by Oracle (e.g., Oracle E-Business Suite R12.1 Financial Management, Oracle E-Business Suite R12.1 Projects, Oracle Customer Hub and Oracle Data Quality). 
•	Achieved demonstrable understanding of a series of modern enterprise IT hardware, software, and storage solutions including Oracle NAS ZFS, Oracle Solaris, SPARC T5-Based Servers, Oracle Database 12c, and HP Vertica Solutions by passing corresponding technical sales certification exams. 
•	Developed a custom app to automate business processes as discussed ealier and installed Oracle database from ground up.

positions.title: Research Technician, Wonderlic, Inc.
positions.description:
•	Assumed primary content programming responsibilities for a large-scale online learning assessment project with a very fast pace, strict delivery deadlines, and a refreshing start-up can-do mentality. 
•	Provided technical assistance to a development team of seven members.  
•	Worked extensively on Javascript programming; greatly improved content uploading efficiency through innovative scripted batch jobs which led to vast accuracy improvement as well.  
•	Achieved programming proficiency with Articulate Storyline, a collection of online learning assessment software suites.  
•	Served as mentor for less experienced staff members.

projects.title: Development of a mobile Web app. (a game randomizer)
projects.description:
•	Led a team to create an app using Javascript, PHP, and HTML.  
•	This mobile Web app randomizes a "Settlers of Catan" game board to provide varied game experience.
•	The managed login feature increases the app’s attractiveness to be adopted as a plug-in for any game engine.  
•	Adhered to mobile programming conventions and deployed assets via GitHub.
